```{r,echo=FALSE}
options(scipen=99)
library(numbers)
pn = function(coeffs,pows){
    pows = pows[coeffs!=0]
    coeffs = coeffs[coeffs!=0]
    ex1 = paste0("{",coeffs,"}x^{",pows,"}",collapse="+")
    ex1 = gsub("+{-","-{",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("{1}x^{0}","1",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("{-1}x^{0}","-1",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("{1}x","x",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("{-1}x","-x",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("x^{0}","",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("x^{1}","x",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("+-","-",ex1,fixed=T)
    if(ex1 == ""){
        ex1 = "0"
    }
    return(ex1)
}

# -b/2a +- sqrt(b^2-4ac)/2a
# (x-(h+i*p*sqrt(q)))(x-(h-i*p*sqrt(q)))
# (x-(h+i*sqrt(p^2*q)))(x-(h-i*sqrt(p^2*q)))
# x^2 - 2*h + h^2+p^2*q

while(T){
    h = sample(1:6,1)*sample(c(-1,1),1)
    p = sample(c(2,3,5),1)
    q = sample(c(2,3,5),1)
    if(p!=q){break}
}

a = 1
b = -2*h
c = h^2+p^2*q

eq = paste0(pn(c(a,b,c),2:0),"=0")

# h+ip*sqrt(q), -h+ip*sqrt(q), h+iq*sqrt(p), -h+iq*sqrt(p)
ex1 = paste0(h,"\\pm",p,"i\\sqrt{",q,"}",collapse="") 
ex2 = paste0(-h,"\\pm",p,"i\\sqrt{",q,"}",collapse="") 
ex3 = paste0(h,"\\pm",q,"i\\sqrt{",p,"}",collapse="") 
ex4 = paste0(-h,"\\pm",q,"i\\sqrt{",p,"}",collapse="") 

ach = sample(c(ex1,ex2,ex3,ex4))

al = paste0("* $x=",ach,"$",collapse="\n")
sol = paste0(1*(ex1==ach),collapse="")

```


Question
========

Solve the equation. $$0=`r pn(c(a,b,c),2:0)`$$

Answerlist
--------

`r al`


Solution
========

Write the equation.

$$`r eq`$$

Identify the coefficients.

$$a=`r a`$$
$$b=`r b`$$
$$c=`r c`$$

Plug numbers into the quadratic formula.

$$x = \frac{-(`r b`)\pm\sqrt{(`r b`)^2-4(`r a`)(`r c`)}}{2(`r a`)} $$

Simplify.

$$x = \frac{`r -b` \pm \sqrt{`r b^2`-`r 4*a*c`}}{`r 2*a`}$$

Simplify.

$$x = \frac{`r -b` \pm \sqrt{`r b^2-4*a*c`}}{`r 2*a`}$$



Use prime factorization.

$$x = \frac{`r -b` \pm \sqrt{(-1)\cdot`r paste0(primeFactors(-b^2+4*a*c),collapse="\\cdot")`}}{`r 2*a`}$$


Isolate the twin factors.

$$x = \frac{`r -b` \pm \sqrt{`r paste0(primeFactors(4*p^2),collapse="\\cdot")`}\cdot\sqrt{-1} \cdot \sqrt{`r paste0(primeFactors(q),collapse="\\cdot")`}}{`r 2*a`}$$

Simplify the square root of the square.

$$x = \frac{`r -b` \pm `r paste0(primeFactors(2*p),collapse="\\cdot")`\cdot i \cdot \sqrt{`r paste0(primeFactors(q),collapse="\\cdot")`}}{`r 2*a`}$$

Simplify the integer products.

$$x = \frac{`r -b` \pm `r 2*p`i \sqrt{`r q`}}{`r 2*a`}$$

Split the fraction.

$$x = \frac{`r -b`}{`r 2*a`} \pm \frac{`r 2*p`i\sqrt{`r q`}}{`r 2*a`}$$

Both numerators contain a factor of 2.

$$x = `r h` \pm `r p`i\sqrt{`r q`}$$
